# Langford sequence L(2,36): length 72, values 1..36
# Two copies of each value v, exactly v+1 positions apart
# (positions are 0-indexed, so positions i and i+v+1 contain value v)

# First, let's check feasibility: L(2,n) exists iff n ≡ 0 or 3 (mod 4)
# 36 mod 4 = 0, so it should exist!

print(f"36 mod 4 = {36 % 4}")
print("L(2,36) should be satisfiable since 36 ≡ 0 (mod 4)")

from pysat.solvers import Glucose4
from pysat.formula import CNF

# Variables: x[v][i] = True means value v is placed at position i (0-indexed)
# For value v (1..36), the two copies go at positions i and i+v+1
# Valid starting positions for v: 0 <= i and i+v+1 <= 71, so i <= 70-v

n = 36
length = 2 * n  # 72

# Variable encoding: var(v, i) = unique positive integer
# v in 1..36, i in 0..71
def var(v, i):
    return (v - 1) * length + i + 1  # 1-indexed

total_vars = n * length

cnf = CNF()

# For each value v, collect valid positions (first copy position)
valid_starts = {}
for v in range(1, n + 1):
    starts = []
    for i in range(length):
        if i + v + 1 < length:
            starts.append(i)
    valid_starts[v] = starts

# Constraint 1: Each value v must be placed at exactly one valid start position
# At least one:
for v in range(1, n + 1):
    clause = [var(v, i) for i in valid_starts[v]]
    cnf.append(clause)

# At most one:
for v in range(1, n + 1):
    starts = valid_starts[v]
    for idx1 in range(len(starts)):
        for idx2 in range(idx1 + 1, len(starts)):
            cnf.append([-var(v, starts[idx1]), -var(v, starts[idx2])])

# Constraint 2: No two values occupy the same position
# For each position p, at most one value covers it
# Value v covers position p if: v is placed at start i where i=p or i+v+1=p
# i.e., i=p (first copy) or i=p-v-1 (second copy)

# For each position p, collect all (v, i) pairs that cover p
position_covers = [[] for _ in range(length)]
for v in range(1, n + 1):
    for i in valid_starts[v]:
        position_covers[i].append(var(v, i))
        position_covers[i + v + 1].append(var(v, i))

# At most one variable true for each position
for p in range(length):
    covers = position_covers[p]
    for idx1 in range(len(covers)):
        for idx2 in range(idx1 + 1, len(covers)):
            cnf.append([-covers[idx1], -covers[idx2]])

# Also: every position must be covered (exactly one value per position)
for p in range(length):
    covers = position_covers[p]
    cnf.append(covers)  # at least one

print(f"Variables: {total_vars}")
print(f"Clauses: {len(cnf.clauses)}")
print("Solving...")

solver = Glucose4()
solver.append_formula(cnf)
result = solver.solve()
print(f"SAT: {result}")

if result:
    model = solver.get_model()
    model_set = set(model)
    
    seq = [0] * length
    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        for i in valid_starts[v]:
            if var(v, i) in model_set:
                seq[i] = v
                seq[i + v + 1] = v
                break
    
    print(f"Sequence: {seq}")
    
    # Verify
    assert len(seq) == 72
    assert all(1 <= x <= 36 for x in seq), "Values out of range"
    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        positions = [i for i, x in enumerate(seq) if x == v]
        assert len(positions) == 2, f"Value {v} appears {len(positions)} times"
        assert positions[1] - positions[0] == v + 1, f"Value {v}: gap {positions[1]-positions[0]} != {v+1}"
    print("VERIFIED CORRECT!")

seq = [6, 11, 1, 36, 1, 20, 18, 6, 24, 2, 30, 5, 2, 11, 4, 27, 10, 5, 3, 4, 35, 32, 3, 34, 25, 18, 20, 10, 26, 21, 13, 7, 31, 24, 28, 33, 22, 29, 14, 7, 36, 30, 17, 27, 13, 19, 23, 9, 12, 16, 25, 21, 15, 14, 32, 26, 35, 9, 34, 22, 17, 12, 8, 28, 31, 19, 16, 29, 15, 33, 23, 8]
print(f"Length: {len(seq)}")
print(f"All values 1-36 present twice: {sorted(set(seq)) == list(range(1,37))}")
print(f"Each value appears exactly twice: {all(seq.count(v)==2 for v in range(1,37))}")
print("\nChecking gaps (v+1 apart):")
all_ok = True
for v in range(1, 37):
    pos = [i for i,x in enumerate(seq) if x==v]
    gap = pos[1] - pos[0]
    if gap != v+1:
        print(f"  FAIL: v={v}, positions={pos}, gap={gap}, expected={v+1}")
        all_ok = False
if all_ok:
    print("  All gaps correct!")
